data_fields.name: listing_fee_rate
data_fields.donor_constant: server 1/100 of gross (game.cpp 5251); client 1/50 of gross (t_market.lua 1667)

best_idea: One shared pure fee function (rate of gross, floor, cap, all as zone data) computes both the server debit and the client preview, so the two cannot drift.
decision_why: Frankendom needs a fee sink on a player market under one ledger: keep the shape (listing fee at creation, buy pays gross plus fee, sell pays fee only) but compute it in one shared function. Reject the donor's duplicated client copy: it already disagrees with the server (2 percent vs 1 percent, round up vs round down, cap 1,000,000 vs 100,000).
acceptance: A server test lists 10 units at 10,000 gold and asserts the buyer is debited 101,000 (100,000 gross plus a 1,000 fee), and the client preview for the same inputs shows 1,000 because both call the same listingFee.
